description: Analyses the recent reviews of 1-3 businesses (Google Maps, Trustpilot or Tripadvisor) and returns per business: a short summary, up to 8 complaint themes and 6 praise themes with mention counts, share and short example excerpts, suggested actions, rating distribution, monthly trend and owner reply rate. No reviewer names. Billed per review analysed plus one report per business. Can take 1-3 minutes; may return a run_id.

google_location.description: Country or city used to find a Google business given by name (default "United States"), e.g. "London,England,United Kingdom".

language.description: Google review language code (default en), e.g. es, fr, de.

reviews_to_analyze.description: Recent reviews to analyse per business (default 50; Trustpilot max 200).

sort_by.description: Review order (default newest). lowest_rating works for Google only.

targets.description: 1-3 businesses, one per item: a Google Maps place URL, place_id:<id> (from find_local_businesses), "Business name, street, city", a Trustpilot URL or trustpilot:<domain>, or a Tripadvisor review page URL.

name: review_summary
title: Review themes and rating trend
